queries.sql: WITH early AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, EventTime, WatchID, IsNotBounce FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-03'), first_touch AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID AS first_source FROM (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID, TraficSourceID) AS rn FROM early) r WHERE rn = 1), user_stats AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS user_hits, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged, COUNT(DISTINCT TraficSourceID) AS sources FROM early GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.first_source, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(s.user_hits) AS avg_hits, CAST(SUM(s.engaged) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(s.user_hits) AS engaged_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN s.sources > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_source_users FROM first_touch f JOIN user_stats s ON f.UserID = s.UserID GROUP BY f.first_source ORDER BY users DESC, f.first_source
queries.description: First-touch attribution over July 1-3: users grouped by the traffic source of their first hit, with their later volume, engagement and multi-source share.

queries.sql: WITH heavy AS (SELECT BrowserCountry, UserID FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserCountry, UserID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000) SELECT c.BrowserCountry, c.users, c.hit_count FROM (SELECT BrowserCountry, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserCountry) AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heavy WHERE heavy.BrowserCountry = c.BrowserCountry) ORDER BY c.hit_count DESC, c.BrowserCountry LIMIT 30
queries.description: Lists browser countries that contain at least one hyperactive user with more than 1000 hits, with their overall traffic.

queries.sql: WITH top_models AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MobilePhoneModel LIMIT 10), mh AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel, ResolutionHeight, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel IN (SELECT MobilePhoneModel FROM top_models) GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel, ResolutionHeight), ranked AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel, ResolutionHeight, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MobilePhoneModel ORDER BY c DESC, ResolutionHeight) AS rn FROM mh) SELECT MobilePhoneModel, rn, ResolutionHeight, MobilePhoneModel || ' @' || CAST(ResolutionHeight AS VARCHAR) AS device_label, c FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY MobilePhoneModel, rn
queries.description: For the 10 most common phone models, lists their three most frequent screen heights with a combined device label.

queries.sql: SELECT FLOOR(CAST(span_min AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 30) * 30 AS span_bucket, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(c) AS hit_count FROM (SELECT UserID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c, MAX(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM ClientEventTime)) - MIN(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM ClientEventTime)) AS span_min FROM hits WHERE CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY UserID, EventDate HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) s GROUP BY span_bucket ORDER BY span_bucket
queries.description: On the busiest counter, distribution of daily client-clock activity spans per user in 30-minute buckets.

queries.sql: WITH ct AS (SELECT BrowserCountry, ClientTimeZone, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserCountry, ClientTimeZone), dom AS (SELECT BrowserCountry, ClientTimeZone FROM (SELECT BrowserCountry, ClientTimeZone, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BrowserCountry ORDER BY c DESC, ClientTimeZone) AS rn FROM ct) AS t WHERE rn = 1), ut AS (SELECT BrowserCountry, UserID, MIN(ClientTimeZone) AS tz_min, MAX(ClientTimeZone) AS tz_max FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserCountry, UserID) SELECT ut.BrowserCountry, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN ut.tz_min = d.ClientTimeZone AND ut.tz_max = d.ClientTimeZone THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS off_zone_users FROM ut JOIN dom AS d ON ut.BrowserCountry = d.BrowserCountry GROUP BY ut.BrowserCountry HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY off_zone_users DESC, users DESC, ut.BrowserCountry LIMIT 25
queries.description: Per browser country, counts users who used any client time zone other than the country's dominant one.

queries.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) SELECT EventDate, c, users FROM daily WHERE EventDate IN (SELECT EventDate FROM daily EXCEPT SELECT EventDate FROM daily WHERE c >= (SELECT AVG(c) FROM daily)) ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: Shows the quiet days whose hit volume is below the average daily volume, with their hit and user counts.

queries.sql: WITH ud AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dy FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), f AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(dy) AS first_day FROM ud GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.first_day, COUNT(DISTINCT f.UserID) AS cohort_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ud.dy = f.first_day + 1 THEN ud.UserID END) AS d1_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ud.dy = f.first_day + 7 THEN ud.UserID END) AS d7_users FROM f JOIN ud ON ud.UserID = f.UserID GROUP BY f.first_day ORDER BY f.first_day
queries.description: Daily acquisition cohorts with the number of users returning exactly one day and seven days after their first visit.

queries.sql: SELECT p.SearchPhrase, p.users, p.hit_count FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50) AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase = p.SearchPhrase AND h.AdvEngineID <> 0) ORDER BY p.users DESC, p.hit_count DESC, p.SearchPhrase LIMIT 20
queries.description: Finds popular search phrases that never co-occur with an ad click, ranked by distinct users.

queries.sql: WITH churned AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY UserID EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate > '2013-07-07' GROUP BY UserID) SELECT TraficSourceID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS churned_users, COUNT(*) AS week1_hits FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM churned) GROUP BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY churned_users DESC, TraficSourceID
queries.description: Traffic sources used during the first week by users who never came back after July 7.

queries.sql: SELECT SearchEngineID, url_prefix, users, rn FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, url_prefix, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SearchEngineID ORDER BY users DESC, url_prefix) AS rn FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, LOWER(SUBSTRING(URL, 1, 24)) AS url_prefix, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 AND URL <> '' GROUP BY SearchEngineID, LOWER(SUBSTRING(URL, 1, 24))) g) r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY SearchEngineID, rn LIMIT 100
queries.description: For each search engine, the three landing URL prefixes reaching the most distinct users.

queries.sql: WITH ud AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dy FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), r AS (SELECT UserID, dy, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY dy) AS rn FROM ud), g AS (SELECT UserID, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN dy END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN dy END) AS gap FROM r WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) = 2) SELECT gap AS days_to_return, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY gap) AS cumulative_users FROM g GROUP BY gap ORDER BY gap
queries.description: Distribution of days between a user's first and second active day, with cumulative returning users.

queries.sql: WITH ip_users AS (SELECT ClientIP, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 20), ip_flags AS (SELECT ClientIP, SUM(CASE WHEN CookieEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nocookie, COUNT(DISTINCT MobilePhoneModel) AS models FROM hits WHERE ClientIP IN (SELECT ClientIP FROM ip_users) GROUP BY ClientIP) SELECT i.ClientIP AS client_ip, i.users AS user_count, i.c AS hit_count, f.nocookie AS nocookie_hits, f.models AS model_count FROM ip_users i INNER JOIN ip_flags f ON i.ClientIP = f.ClientIP ORDER BY user_count DESC, hit_count DESC, client_ip LIMIT 30
queries.description: Finds client IPs shared by many user IDs (possible bot farms) together with their cookie-less hit counts and device model diversity.

queries.sql: SELECT n.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS search_users_with_ad_click FROM (SELECT EventDate, UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID > 0 AND IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY EventDate, UserID) n WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.UserID = n.UserID AND h.EventDate = n.EventDate AND h.AdvEngineID > 0) GROUP BY n.EventDate ORDER BY n.EventDate
queries.description: Per day, users arriving from a search engine who also had an ad-driven hit on the same day.

queries.sql: SELECT dim, val, views, users, rn FROM (SELECT dim, val, views, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dim ORDER BY views DESC, val) AS rn FROM (SELECT 'source' AS dim, UTMSource AS val, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '' GROUP BY UTMSource UNION ALL SELECT 'medium' AS dim, UTMMedium AS val, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE UTMMedium <> '' GROUP BY UTMMedium UNION ALL SELECT 'content' AS dim, UTMContent AS val, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE UTMContent <> '' GROUP BY UTMContent) AS u) AS r WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY dim, rn
queries.description: Shows the five most frequent values of each UTM tag (source, medium, content) with their view and user counts.

queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07') AS first_week_users, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25') AS last_week_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY UserID INTERSECT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25' GROUP BY UserID) x) AS retained_users ORDER BY first_week_users
queries.description: Users active in the first week, in the last week, and in both (month-long retention).

queries.sql: WITH first_hit AS (SELECT UserID, CASE WHEN UTMSource <> '' THEN 'utm' WHEN SocialSourcePage <> '' THEN 'social' WHEN SearchEngineID <> 0 THEN 'search' WHEN FromTag <> '' THEN 'tagged' ELSE 'direct' END AS channel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-03'), days AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.channel AS first_channel, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(AVG(d.active_days), 2) AS avg_active_days, SUM(CASE WHEN d.active_days >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loyal_users FROM first_hit f JOIN days d ON f.UserID = d.UserID WHERE f.rn = 1 GROUP BY f.channel ORDER BY users DESC, first_channel
queries.description: Retention by the acquisition channel of each early user's first hit: average active days and count of users active seven or more days.

queries.sql: WITH early AS (SELECT UserID, MAX(Income) AS income_band FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UserID), late AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UserID) SELECT e.income_band, COUNT(*) AS churned_users FROM early e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM late l WHERE l.UserID = e.UserID) GROUP BY e.income_band ORDER BY e.income_band
queries.description: Number of users active in the first half of July who never returned in the second half, by income band.

queries.sql: SELECT TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT UserID), 2) AS hits_per_user FROM hits GROUP BY TraficSourceID HAVING CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= (SELECT AVG(r) FROM (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS r FROM hits GROUP BY TraficSourceID) z) ORDER BY hits_per_user DESC, TraficSourceID
queries.description: Traffic sources whose hits-per-user depth is at or above the average depth across all sources.

queries.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS sec FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-15'), g AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, sec, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN sec - MAX(sec) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_sess FROM t), s AS (SELECT UserID, SUM(new_sess) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sess_no FROM g), sz AS (SELECT UserID, sess_no, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY UserID, sess_no) SELECT CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN '1 hit' WHEN n <= 3 THEN '2-3 hits' WHEN n <= 10 THEN '4-10 hits' WHEN n <= 30 THEN '11-30 hits' ELSE '31+ hits' END AS session_size, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM sz GROUP BY CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN '1 hit' WHEN n <= 3 THEN '2-3 hits' WHEN n <= 10 THEN '4-10 hits' WHEN n <= 30 THEN '11-30 hits' ELSE '31+ hits' END ORDER BY MIN(n)
queries.description: Sessionizes July 15 traffic with a 30-minute inactivity gap and buckets sessions by their number of hits.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, ClientTimeZone, hit_count, refreshes, refresh_rate, rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, ClientTimeZone, hit_count, refreshes, CAST(refreshes AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / hit_count AS refresh_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY CAST(refreshes AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / hit_count DESC, ClientTimeZone) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, ClientTimeZone, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN IsRefresh = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refreshes FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-14' GROUP BY EventDate, ClientTimeZone HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) g) r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY EventDate, rn
queries.description: For each day of the second week, the two time zones with the highest refresh rate among those with at least 1000 hits.

queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID, UserID), tot AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS search_users FROM s GROUP BY SearchEngineID), conv AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS linking_users FROM s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits l WHERE l.UserID = s.UserID AND l.IsLink = 1) GROUP BY SearchEngineID) SELECT tot.SearchEngineID, tot.search_users, COALESCE(conv.linking_users, 0) AS linking_user_count, CAST(COALESCE(conv.linking_users, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tot.search_users AS link_rate FROM tot LEFT JOIN conv ON tot.SearchEngineID = conv.SearchEngineID ORDER BY tot.search_users DESC, tot.SearchEngineID LIMIT 20
queries.description: For each search engine, the share of its users who ever clicked an outbound link.

queries.sql: SELECT RefererCategoryID, COUNT(*) AS hits_count, SUM(CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%.html%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS html_pages, SUM(CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_query, SUM(CASE WHEN Referer LIKE 'https://%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS secure_referers, COUNT(DISTINCT RefererHash) AS distinct_referers FROM hits WHERE Referer <> '' GROUP BY RefererCategoryID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY hits_count DESC, RefererCategoryID LIMIT 15
queries.description: For referred traffic per referer category, counts landing pages that are HTML or carry query strings, HTTPS referers and distinct referers.

queries.sql: WITH tc AS (SELECT BrowserCountry FROM hits WHERE BrowserCountry <> '' GROUP BY BrowserCountry ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) DESC, BrowserCountry LIMIT 5), x AS (SELECT BrowserCountry, Title, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE Title <> '' AND BrowserCountry IN (SELECT BrowserCountry FROM tc) GROUP BY BrowserCountry, Title), r AS (SELECT BrowserCountry, Title, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BrowserCountry ORDER BY users DESC, Title) AS rn FROM x) SELECT BrowserCountry, Title, users, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY BrowserCountry, rn
queries.description: Top three page titles by audience in each of the five largest browser countries.

queries.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS u FROM hits WHERE BrowserCountry = (SELECT BrowserCountry FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserCountry ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, BrowserCountry LIMIT 1) GROUP BY EventDate), numbered AS (SELECT EventDate, c, u, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY EventDate) AS rn FROM daily) SELECT a.EventDate, a.c AS hit_count, a.u AS users, CAST(a.c AS BIGINT) - CAST(b.c AS BIGINT) AS delta_hits, CAST(a.u AS BIGINT) - CAST(b.u AS BIGINT) AS delta_users FROM numbered a JOIN numbered b ON a.rn = b.rn + 1 ORDER BY a.EventDate
queries.description: For the busiest browser country, shows day-over-day changes in hits and distinct users to spot sudden traffic spikes.

queries.sql: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nojs, SUM(CASE WHEN CookieEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nocookie FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 100) a INTERSECT SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE CookieEnable = 0 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 100) b) x) GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY nojs DESC, nocookie DESC, CounterID
queries.description: Profiles counters that are in both the top 100 by JavaScript-less hits and the top 100 by cookie-less hits.

queries.sql: SELECT u.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS direct_only_users, SUM(u.hit_count) AS hits_total FROM (SELECT EventDate, UserID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20) AS u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.UserID = u.UserID AND h.EventDate = u.EventDate AND h.Referer <> '') GROUP BY u.EventDate ORDER BY u.EventDate
queries.description: Per day, counts busy users (20+ hits) who never arrived with a referer on that day, a typical sign of scripted direct traffic.

queries.sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT EventDate, IsDownload, IsLink, Referer, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID, EventDate ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-07') SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(IsDownload) AS first_download, SUM(IsLink) AS first_link, SUM(CASE WHEN Referer = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_direct FROM firsts WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: For the first week of July, inspects each user's first hit of the day and counts how often it is a download, an outbound link or a direct entry.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN hit_count >= 100 THEN 3 WHEN hit_count >= 30 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS burst_tier, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(hit_count) AS hits_total, SUM(refreshes) AS refreshes_total FROM (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(IsRefresh) AS refreshes, MIN(EventTime) AS t_first, MAX(EventTime) AS t_last FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10) AS u WHERE DATE_TRUNC('hour', t_first) = DATE_TRUNC('hour', t_last) GROUP BY burst_tier ORDER BY burst_tier
queries.description: Tiers users who made 10+ hits whose entire lifetime fits within one clock hour, a burst-bot pattern.

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bounced_only_ips, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) FROM hits WHERE HasGCLID = 1) AS gclid_ips FROM (SELECT ClientIP FROM hits WHERE HasGCLID = 1 GROUP BY ClientIP EXCEPT SELECT ClientIP FROM hits WHERE IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY ClientIP) t ORDER BY bounced_only_ips
queries.description: Number of IPs that produced GCLID clicks but never a single engaged hit, against all GCLID IPs.

queries.sql: WITH paid AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS paid_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS paid_counters FROM hits WHERE HasGCLID = 1 OR AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID), behaviour AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged, SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nojs FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM paid) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT p.UserID AS user_id, p.paid_hits AS paid_hit_count, p.paid_counters AS paid_counter_count, b.total AS total_hits, b.engaged AS engaged_hits, b.nojs AS nojs_hits, CAST(p.paid_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / b.total AS paid_share FROM paid p INNER JOIN behaviour b ON p.UserID = b.UserID WHERE p.paid_hits >= 10 ORDER BY paid_share DESC, paid_hit_count DESC, user_id LIMIT 50
queries.description: Click-fraud check: for users with at least 10 paid-ad hits, compares paid traffic with their overall engagement and JavaScript-less hits.

queries.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_date FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT u.first_date, COUNT(*) AS never_engaged_users FROM u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.UserID = u.UserID AND h.IsNotBounce = 1) GROUP BY u.first_date ORDER BY u.first_date
queries.description: Per acquisition date, users who never produced a single non-bounce hit during the month.

queries.sql: SELECT scheme, has_query, COUNT(*) AS views, AVG(url_len) AS avg_len, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS counters FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS scheme, CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_query, CHAR_LENGTH(URL) AS url_len, CounterID FROM hits WHERE URL <> '') AS s GROUP BY scheme, has_query ORDER BY scheme, has_query
queries.description: Breaks page views down by URL scheme and presence of a query string, with average URL length and number of sites.

queries.sql: WITH langs AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND BrowserLanguage <> '' GROUP BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, BrowserLanguage LIMIT 5), ph AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND BrowserLanguage IN (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM langs) GROUP BY BrowserLanguage, SearchPhrase), ranked AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage, SearchPhrase, users, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY users DESC, c DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM ph) SELECT BrowserLanguage, rn, SearchPhrase, users, c FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY BrowserLanguage, rn
queries.description: For the five most search-active browser languages, lists the three search phrases reaching the most distinct users.

queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT ClientTimeZone, (CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) + 24) % 24 AS hour_shift, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY ClientTimeZone, (CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) + 24) % 24) SELECT ClientTimeZone, hour_shift, c, total, CAST(c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(total, 0) AS share FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, hour_shift, c, SUM(c) OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY c DESC, hour_shift) AS rn FROM s) AS t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY total DESC, ClientTimeZone LIMIT 50
queries.description: For each client time zone, finds the dominant hour offset between the client clock and the server clock and its share of hits.

queries.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT UserID, CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 'ad' WHEN SearchEngineID <> 0 THEN 'search' WHEN SocialSourceNetworkID <> 0 THEN 'social' WHEN UTMSource <> '' THEN 'utm' ELSE 'other' END AS channel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn FROM hits), first_touch AS (SELECT UserID, channel FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1), totals AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged, SUM(IsDownload) AS downloads FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.channel, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(t.hits_cnt) AS avg_hits_per_user, AVG(CAST(t.engaged AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_engaged_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.downloads > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downloading_users FROM first_touch f INNER JOIN totals t ON f.UserID = t.UserID GROUP BY f.channel ORDER BY users DESC, f.channel
queries.description: First-touch attribution: groups users by the channel of their very first hit and compares lifetime hits, engagement and downloads.

queries.sql: SELECT o.OS, o.users, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) FROM hits h WHERE h.OS = o.OS AND h.IsNotBounce = 1) AS engaged_users FROM (SELECT OS, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY OS ORDER BY users DESC, OS LIMIT 10) o ORDER BY o.users DESC, o.OS
queries.description: For the ten largest operating systems, total users versus users with at least one non-bounce hit.

queries.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS hits_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROUND(AVG(HistoryLength), 2) AS avg_history, SUM(CASE WHEN IsNotBounce = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged_hits FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) >= 5) THEN 'explorer' ELSE 'other' END AS segment, UserID, HistoryLength, IsNotBounce FROM hits) t GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment
queries.description: Compares explorer users (at least 5 distinct search phrases) with everyone else on volume, history length and engagement.

queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) SELECT h.EventDate, h.hr, h.c FROM h WHERE h.c = (SELECT MAX(h2.c) FROM h h2 WHERE h2.EventDate = h.EventDate) ORDER BY h.EventDate, h.hr LIMIT 100
queries.description: The peak hour of ad traffic for each day, found with a correlated maximum; tied hours are all returned.

queries.sql: SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS downloads, COUNT(DISTINCT URL) AS files, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS days FROM hits WHERE IsDownload = 1 AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE IsDownload = 1 GROUP BY UserID EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE IsDownload = 0 GROUP BY UserID) t) GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY downloads DESC, UserID LIMIT 50
queries.description: Finds users whose only activity is downloads, never an ordinary page view, ranked by the number of downloads.

queries.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, TraficSourceID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime) * 86400 + EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS sec FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-10' AND IsArtifical = 0), m AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, TraficSourceID, sec, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID, TraficSourceID) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN sec - MAX(sec) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID, TraficSourceID ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_start FROM t), s AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, sec, is_start, SUM(is_start) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID, TraficSourceID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sess_no FROM m), sess AS (SELECT UserID, sess_no, MAX(CASE WHEN is_start = 1 THEN TraficSourceID END) AS entry_source, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(sec) - MIN(sec) AS duration_sec FROM s GROUP BY UserID, sess_no) SELECT entry_source, COUNT(*) AS sessions, ROUND(AVG(duration_sec), 1) AS avg_duration_sec, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS single_hit_pct, MAX(n) AS max_hits FROM sess GROUP BY entry_source ORDER BY sessions DESC, entry_source
queries.description: Builds 30-minute-gap sessions over three days of non-artificial traffic and compares session count, duration and single-hit share by the traffic source of the session's first hit.

queries.sql: WITH busy AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, CounterID LIMIT 20) SELECT b.CounterID, b.c, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.CounterID = b.CounterID AND h.OpenstatServiceName <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_openstat, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.CounterID = b.CounterID AND h.SocialNetwork <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_social FROM busy b ORDER BY b.c DESC, b.CounterID
queries.description: For the 20 busiest counters, flags whether each ever received Openstat-tagged or social-network traffic.

queries.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(IsRefresh) AS refreshes, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) HAVING CAST(SUM(IsRefresh) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(SUM(IsRefresh) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) ORDER BY hr
queries.description: Shows the hours of the day whose refresh rate is above the overall refresh rate.

queries.sql: WITH dau AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate), fd AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_date FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), nu AS (SELECT first_date, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM fd GROUP BY first_date) SELECT dau.EventDate, dau.users, nu.new_users, ROUND(AVG(dau.users) OVER (ORDER BY dau.EventDate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS dau_7d_avg, SUM(nu.new_users) OVER (ORDER BY dau.EventDate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM dau JOIN nu ON nu.first_date = dau.EventDate ORDER BY dau.EventDate
queries.description: Daily active users with a 7-day rolling average, new users per day and the cumulative user base.

queries.sql: SELECT h.ClientTimeZone AS tz, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS churned_users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits h JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-08' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08') c ON h.UserID = c.UserID GROUP BY h.ClientTimeZone ORDER BY churned_users DESC, tz LIMIT 25
queries.description: Time zones of users seen in the first week who never returned afterwards.

queries.sql: SELECT proto, has_utm, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(URL)) AS avg_url_len FROM (SELECT URL, CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS proto, CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%utm%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_utm FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 OR UTMSource <> '') t GROUP BY proto, has_utm ORDER BY c DESC, proto, has_utm
queries.description: For campaign traffic, breaks landing URLs down by protocol and by whether they contain utm tagging, with the average URL length in characters.

queries.sql: WITH top_counters AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 5), weekly AS (SELECT CounterID, CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) AS wk, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS paid_users, COUNT(*) AS paid_hits, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counters) GROUP BY CounterID, CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER)) SELECT CounterID, wk, paid_users, paid_hits, CAST(engaged AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / paid_hits AS engaged_rate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wk ORDER BY paid_users DESC, CounterID) AS week_rank FROM weekly ORDER BY wk, week_rank
queries.description: Weekly paid reach and engagement for the five biggest paid-traffic sites, ranked against each other within each week of July.

queries.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT MobilePhone, MobilePhoneModel, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS u FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone > 0 AND MobilePhoneModel <> '' GROUP BY MobilePhone, MobilePhoneModel HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 5), r AS (SELECT MobilePhone, MobilePhoneModel, c, u, CAST(c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / u AS hits_per_user, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MobilePhone ORDER BY CAST(c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / u DESC, c DESC, MobilePhoneModel) AS rn FROM m) SELECT MobilePhone, MobilePhoneModel, c, u, hits_per_user, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY MobilePhone, rn LIMIT 100
queries.description: For each mobile phone vendor code, picks the three models with the most hits per user, which may indicate emulator farms.

queries.sql: SELECT c.URLCategoryID, c.hit_count, c.users FROM (SELECT URLCategoryID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY URLCategoryID) c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.URLCategoryID = c.URLCategoryID AND h.IsMobile = 1 AND h.HTTPError > 0) ORDER BY c.hit_count DESC, c.URLCategoryID LIMIT 30
queries.description: URL categories that never served an HTTP error to a mobile visitor, ranked by traffic.

queries.sql: SELECT hr, c, wh, SUM(c) OVER (ORDER BY hr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_hits, CAST(wh AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / c AS hash_share FROM (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(WithHash) AS wh FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1) GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER)) t ORDER BY hr
queries.description: On the busiest day, shows hourly hits, a running total and the share of URLs with a hash fragment.

queries.sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID, EventDate FROM hits) SELECT f.first_day AS first_day, COUNT(DISTINCT f.UserID) AS cohort_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.EventDate = f.first_day + 1 THEN a.UserID END) AS back_next_day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.EventDate >= f.first_day + 7 THEN a.UserID END) AS back_after_week FROM firsts f JOIN activity a ON a.UserID = f.UserID GROUP BY f.first_day ORDER BY first_day
queries.description: Daily first-seen cohorts with next-day and seven-plus-day return counts.

queries.sql: SELECT URLRegionID, UTMMedium, hit_count, rn FROM (SELECT URLRegionID, UTMMedium, hit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY URLRegionID ORDER BY hit_count DESC, UTMMedium) AS rn FROM (SELECT URLRegionID, UTMMedium, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE UTMMedium <> '' AND URLRegionID IN (SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE UTMMedium <> '' GROUP BY URLRegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, URLRegionID LIMIT 10) GROUP BY URLRegionID, UTMMedium) g) x WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY URLRegionID, rn
queries.description: Within the ten URL regions with the most UTM-medium traffic, the two dominant UTM media per region.

queries.sql: WITH lost AS (SELECT DISTINCT RegionID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-08' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT RegionID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-22') SELECT h.RegionID, COUNT(*) AS early_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS early_users, MAX(h.EventDate) AS last_seen FROM hits h JOIN lost l ON h.RegionID = l.RegionID GROUP BY h.RegionID ORDER BY early_hits DESC, h.RegionID LIMIT 25
queries.description: Regions active in the first week of July but silent in the last ten days, with their volume and last activity date.

queries.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, MAX(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS searched, MAX(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saw_ad, MAX(CASE WHEN IsEvent = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_event FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), seg AS (SELECT searched, saw_ad, had_event, COUNT(*) AS users FROM u GROUP BY searched, saw_ad, had_event) SELECT searched, saw_ad, had_event, users, CAST(users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (SELECT SUM(users) FROM seg) AS user_share FROM seg ORDER BY searched, saw_ad, had_event
queries.description: User segmentation by whether they searched, saw ads and triggered events, with each segment's share of all users.

queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS BIGINT) AS sec FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-15'), g AS (SELECT UserID, sec - LAG(sec, 1, CAST(-100000 AS BIGINT)) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID) AS gap FROM s) SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS hits_day, SUM(CASE WHEN gap <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rapid, SUM(CASE WHEN gap >= 1800 AND gap < 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_pauses FROM g GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY rapid DESC, hits_day DESC, UserID LIMIT 30
queries.description: On July 15, measures the gaps between consecutive hits of each heavy user and ranks users by the number of machine-speed follow-ups at most one second apart.

queries.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) SELECT d.EventDate, d.users FROM daily d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily p WHERE p.EventDate < d.EventDate AND p.users >= d.users) ORDER BY d.EventDate
queries.description: Days that set a new record for daily unique users compared to all earlier days.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Title) = 0 THEN 'empty' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Title) <= 20 THEN '1-20' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Title) <= 40 THEN '21-40' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Title) <= 80 THEN '41-80' ELSE '81+' END AS title_len, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(IsNotBounce) / COUNT(*), 2) AS engaged_pct FROM hits GROUP BY CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Title) = 0 THEN 'empty' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Title) <= 20 THEN '1-20' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Title) <= 40 THEN '21-40' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Title) <= 80 THEN '41-80' ELSE '81+' END ORDER BY MIN(CHAR_LENGTH(Title))
queries.description: Engagement rate and audience by page title length bucket.

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS suspicious_users FROM (SELECT UserID FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT BrowserCountry) >= 2 INTERSECT SELECT UserID FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ClientTimeZone) >= 2) AS x ORDER BY suspicious_users
queries.description: Counts users who appear with at least two browser countries and also with at least two client time zones.

queries.sql: WITH w1 AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage AS lang, 1 AS present, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_w1 FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY BrowserLanguage), w4 AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage AS lang, 1 AS present, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_w4 FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-22' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-28' GROUP BY BrowserLanguage) SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(w1.present, 0) = 1 THEN w1.lang ELSE w4.lang END AS browser_lang, COALESCE(w1.users_w1, 0) AS week1_users, COALESCE(w4.users_w4, 0) AS week4_users, COALESCE(w4.users_w4, 0) - COALESCE(w1.users_w1, 0) AS user_delta FROM w1 FULL OUTER JOIN w4 ON w1.lang = w4.lang ORDER BY user_delta DESC, browser_lang LIMIT 25
queries.description: Browser languages with the largest growth in distinct users between the first and the fourth week of July.

queries.sql: WITH ad AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase), org AS (SELECT DISTINCT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID = 0 AND SearchPhrase <> '') SELECT ad.SearchPhrase, ad.c, ad.users FROM ad WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM org WHERE org.SearchPhrase = ad.SearchPhrase) ORDER BY ad.c DESC, ad.users DESC, ad.SearchPhrase LIMIT 20
queries.description: Search phrases that appear only with paid ad traffic and never with organic traffic, ranked by hits.

queries.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(CASE WHEN Referer = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS direct_c, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS days FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) SELECT CASE WHEN direct_c = c THEN 'always_direct' WHEN direct_c = 0 THEN 'always_referred' ELSE 'mixed' END AS segment, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(AVG(c), 2) AS avg_hits, ROUND(AVG(days), 2) AS avg_days FROM u GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment
queries.description: Segments users with at least 5 hits by whether they always, never or sometimes arrive without a referer and compares their activity.

queries.sql: WITH day_tot AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS total FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate), reg AS (SELECT EventDate, URLRegionID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, URLRegionID), ranked AS (SELECT EventDate, URLRegionID, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC, URLRegionID) AS rn FROM reg) SELECT r.EventDate AS day, r.URLRegionID AS top_region, r.c AS region_hits, t.total AS day_hits, CAST(r.c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) AS share FROM ranked r JOIN day_tot t ON r.EventDate = t.EventDate WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY day
queries.description: The single busiest URL region per day and its share of that day's traffic.

queries.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage, UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT FUniqID) AS fu FROM hits WHERE FUniqID <> 0 GROUP BY BrowserLanguage, UserID) SELECT BrowserLanguage, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN fu > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_cookie_users, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fu > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS churn_share FROM u GROUP BY BrowserLanguage HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY users DESC, BrowserLanguage LIMIT 20
queries.description: Cookie churn by browser language: the share of users seen with more than one FUniqID.

queries.sql: WITH paid AS (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase), org AS (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID = 0 AND SearchEngineID <> 0 AND SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase) SELECT COUNT(*) AS overlap_phrases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paid) AS paid_phrases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org) AS organic_phrases FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM paid INTERSECT SELECT SearchPhrase FROM org) x ORDER BY overlap_phrases
queries.description: Keyword cannibalization check: number of search phrases seen in both paid and organic search traffic versus each total.

queries.sql: SELECT word_count, COUNT(*) AS hits_count, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS distinct_phrases, ROUND(AVG(phrase_len), 2) AS avg_chars FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase, CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(SearchPhrase)) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(TRIM(SearchPhrase), ' ', '')) + 1 AS word_count, CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase) AS phrase_len FROM hits WHERE TRIM(SearchPhrase) <> '') t GROUP BY word_count ORDER BY word_count LIMIT 30
queries.description: Estimates the number of words in each search phrase and reports volume, distinct phrases and average length per word count.

queries.sql: SELECT a.URLRegionID, a.c AS first_half_hits, b.c AS second_half_hits, CAST(b.c AS BIGINT) - CAST(a.c AS BIGINT) AS delta FROM (SELECT URLRegionID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY URLRegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500) a JOIN (SELECT URLRegionID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY URLRegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500) b ON a.URLRegionID = b.URLRegionID ORDER BY delta DESC, a.URLRegionID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Compares URL region traffic between the first and second half of July and lists the regions with the largest growth.

queries.sql: SELECT wk, MobilePhoneModel, c, rnk FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', EventTime) AS wk, MobilePhoneModel, COUNT(*) AS c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('week', EventTime) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MobilePhoneModel) AS rnk FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', EventTime), MobilePhoneModel) t WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY wk, rnk
queries.description: The three most-hit mobile phone models in each calendar week.

queries.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN HTTPError > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_hits, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(IsNotBounce) / COUNT(*), 2) AS engaged_pct FROM hits WHERE CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) ORDER BY hr
queries.description: Hour-of-day profile of users, errors and engagement for the counter with the largest audience.

queries.sql: SELECT d.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS users_multi_tz FROM (SELECT EventDate, UserID, MIN(ClientTimeZone) AS tz FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, UserID) AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.UserID = d.UserID AND h.EventDate = d.EventDate AND h.ClientTimeZone <> d.tz) GROUP BY d.EventDate ORDER BY d.EventDate
queries.description: Per day, counts users who reported more than one client time zone on the same day.

queries.sql: WITH ud AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate), fs AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM ud GROUP BY UserID) SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM fs.first_day) AS cohort_day, EXTRACT(DAY FROM ud.EventDate) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM fs.first_day) AS day_offset, COUNT(*) AS active_users FROM ud JOIN fs ON ud.UserID = fs.UserID WHERE fs.first_day <= '2013-07-07' AND ud.EventDate <= '2013-07-14' GROUP BY cohort_day, day_offset ORDER BY cohort_day, day_offset
queries.description: Builds a daily retention matrix for user cohorts first seen in the first week of July.

queries.sql: WITH early AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY CounterID), late AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY CounterID), lapsed AS (SELECT CounterID FROM early EXCEPT SELECT CounterID FROM late) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lapsed) AS lapsed_counters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM early) AS early_counters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM late) AS late_counters ORDER BY lapsed_counters
queries.description: Counts sites that received paid traffic in the first half of July but none in the second half, next to the totals for each half.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN Referer = '' THEN 'empty' WHEN Referer LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN Referer LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS scheme, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(Referer)) AS avg_len, SUM(CASE WHEN Referer = URL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS self_referrals, SUM(CASE WHEN Referer LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_query, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS u FROM hits GROUP BY CASE WHEN Referer = '' THEN 'empty' WHEN Referer LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN Referer LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END ORDER BY c DESC, scheme
queries.description: Breaks down hits by referer scheme, with the average referer length, self-referral loops and referers carrying query strings.

queries.sql: SELECT ClientTimeZone, hour_offset, hit_count FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, hour_offset, hit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY hit_count DESC, hour_offset) AS rn FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) - EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) + 24) % 24 AS hour_offset, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY ClientTimeZone, (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) - EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) + 24) % 24) g) r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY ClientTimeZone LIMIT 100
queries.description: For each client time zone, the most common hour offset between client clock and server event time.

queries.sql: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS ad_users FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 EXCEPT SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE SocialSourceNetworkID <> 0) GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY ad_hits DESC, CounterID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Counters that receive ad traffic but no social-network traffic, ranked by ad hits.

queries.sql: SELECT a.AdvEngineID, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(a.ad_hits) AS ad_hits_total FROM (SELECT AdvEngineID, UserID, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY AdvEngineID, UserID) AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.UserID = a.UserID AND h.IsRefresh = 1 AND h.AdvEngineID = 0) GROUP BY a.AdvEngineID ORDER BY users DESC, a.AdvEngineID
queries.description: Per ad engine, counts ad-clicking users who also refreshed non-ad pages, together with their ad hits.

queries.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) * 1440 + CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS m FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0), g AS (SELECT m, LEAD(m, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY m, WatchID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_m FROM t) SELECT gap_bucket, COUNT(*) AS gaps FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN next_m - m < 1 THEN 0 WHEN next_m - m < 10 THEN 1 WHEN next_m - m < 60 THEN 2 WHEN next_m - m < 1440 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS gap_bucket FROM g WHERE next_m >= 0) b GROUP BY gap_bucket ORDER BY gap_bucket
queries.description: Distribution of the time gaps, in minutes, between a user's consecutive ad-driven hits, grouped into recency buckets.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN UTMTerm = '' THEN 'none' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(UTMTerm) <= 8 THEN 'short' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(UTMTerm) <= 20 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'long' END AS term_bucket, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMTerm) AS distinct_terms, AVG(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN IsLink = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS link_rate FROM hits GROUP BY term_bucket ORDER BY term_bucket
queries.description: Engagement and outbound-link rates by length bucket of the UTM keyword.

queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_ad, LAG(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS prev_ad FROM hits WHERE CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1)) SELECT prev_ad, is_ad, COUNT(*) AS transitions FROM s GROUP BY prev_ad, is_ad ORDER BY prev_ad, is_ad
queries.description: On the busiest counter, a transition matrix between a user's consecutive hits from ad and non-ad sources, where -1 marks the user's first hit.

queries.sql: WITH busiest AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), daily AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nojs FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM busiest) GROUP BY EventDate) SELECT EventDate, c, nojs, CAST(c AS BIGINT) - LAG(CAST(c AS BIGINT), 1, CAST(c AS BIGINT)) OVER (ORDER BY EventDate) AS delta, AVG(nojs) OVER (ORDER BY EventDate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS nojs_ma3 FROM daily ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: For the busiest counter, shows daily hits, the day-over-day change and a 3-day moving average of hits with JavaScript disabled.

queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)), r AS (SELECT EventDate, hr, c, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC, hr) AS rk FROM h) SELECT EventDate, hr AS peak_hour, c AS paid_hits FROM r WHERE rk = 1 ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: For each day, the hour with the most paid-ad hits.

queries.sql: SELECT distinct_widths, COUNT(*) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT ResolutionWidth) AS distinct_widths FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ResolutionWidth) >= 2) AS u GROUP BY distinct_widths ORDER BY distinct_widths LIMIT 50
queries.description: Distribution of device-switching users by how many different screen widths they used.

queries.sql: WITH ad_days AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0), search_days AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID = 0 AND SearchEngineID <> 0 AND IsRefresh = 0) SELECT a.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS ad_users_also_searching FROM ad_days a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_days s WHERE s.UserID = a.UserID AND s.EventDate = a.EventDate) GROUP BY a.EventDate ORDER BY a.EventDate
queries.description: Per day, counts users who arrived through an ad and also arrived through organic search on the same day.

queries.sql: SELECT CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(UTMContent)) AS content_len, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMContent) AS distinct_contents, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN UTMContent LIKE '%-%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hyphenated FROM hits WHERE UTMContent <> '' GROUP BY content_len ORDER BY hit_count DESC, content_len LIMIT 25
queries.description: UTM content values grouped by trimmed character length, with variety, reach and hyphenated counts.

queries.sql: WITH hourly AS (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)), ranked AS (SELECT EventDate, hr, c, SUM(c) OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate) AS day_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC, hr) AS rn FROM hourly) SELECT EventDate, hr AS zenith_hour, c AS zenith_hits, day_total FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: Finds the zenith (busiest) hour of each day for non-refresh hits together with the day's total.

queries.sql: SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM (SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' GROUP BY UserAgentMajor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 INTERSECT SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel = '' GROUP BY UserAgentMajor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) t ORDER BY UserAgentMajor LIMIT 100
queries.description: Lists major browser versions that are well represented both on devices with a phone model and on devices without one.

queries.sql: SELECT h.RefererCategoryID, COUNT(*) AS engaged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users FROM hits h WHERE h.IsNotBounce = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits s WHERE s.UserID = h.UserID AND (s.SocialAction <> '' OR s.SocialSourceNetworkID <> 0)) GROUP BY h.RefererCategoryID ORDER BY engaged_hits DESC, h.RefererCategoryID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Referrer categories of engaged hits from users who have shown any social-network activity.

queries.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT CounterID, AdvEngineID, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, AdvEngineID) SELECT c1.CounterID, c1.AdvEngineID, c1.hit_cnt, (SELECT SUM(c2.hit_cnt) FROM c c2 WHERE c2.CounterID = c1.CounterID) AS counter_total FROM c c1 WHERE c1.AdvEngineID <> 0 ORDER BY c1.hit_cnt DESC, c1.CounterID, c1.AdvEngineID LIMIT 15
queries.description: The largest counter and ad engine combinations by hits, each shown next to the counter's total traffic from a correlated scalar subquery.

queries.sql: SELECT d, new_users, single_hit_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY d) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT first_day AS d, COUNT(*) AS new_users, SUM(CASE WHEN hit_count = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_hit_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) AS f GROUP BY first_day) AS g ORDER BY d
queries.description: Counts newly seen users per day, how many of them never came back after one hit, and the running total of users.

queries.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0), an AS (SELECT UserID, d, d + 1 AS nd FROM a WHERE d < 31), v AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS vd FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID = 0) SELECT an.d AS day_of_month, COUNT(*) AS ad_users, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.vd, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_organic_next_day FROM an LEFT JOIN v ON v.UserID = an.UserID AND v.vd = an.nd GROUP BY an.d ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: Next-day organic return of ad-reached users: for each day, how many ad users came back without an ad on the following day.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN OriginalURL LIKE '%gclid=%' THEN 'gclid' WHEN OriginalURL LIKE '%utm_source=%' THEN 'utm' WHEN OriginalURL LIKE '%openstat%' THEN 'openstat' WHEN OriginalURL LIKE '%?%' THEN 'other_params' WHEN OriginalURL <> '' THEN 'plain' ELSE 'missing' END AS url_marker, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, AVG(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_rate FROM hits GROUP BY url_marker ORDER BY url_marker
queries.description: Classifies hits by the campaign marker found in the original URL and compares their reach and engagement.

queries.sql: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM first_seen GROUP BY first_day ORDER BY first_day
queries.description: Counts newly seen users per day and their running cumulative total.

queries.sql: SELECT a.OS, a.users AS users_first_half, b.users AS users_second_half, ROUND(100.0 * b.users / a.users, 2) AS second_vs_first_pct FROM (SELECT OS, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-15' GROUP BY OS) a JOIN (SELECT OS, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE EventDate > '2013-07-15' GROUP BY OS) b ON a.OS = b.OS WHERE a.users >= 500 ORDER BY second_vs_first_pct DESC, a.OS LIMIT 15
queries.description: Audience change per operating system between the first and second half of July.

queries.sql: WITH rd AS (SELECT EventDate, RegionID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, RegionID) SELECT a.EventDate, a.RegionID, a.c FROM rd a WHERE a.c = (SELECT MAX(b.c) FROM rd b WHERE b.EventDate = a.EventDate) ORDER BY a.EventDate, a.RegionID LIMIT 100
queries.description: The leading region by hits for each day, found with a correlated maximum subquery.

queries.sql: SELECT ClientTimeZone, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS organic_users, COUNT(*) AS pageviews, AVG(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_rate FROM hits WHERE TraficSourceID = 2 AND UserID NOT IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0) GROUP BY ClientTimeZone HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY organic_users DESC, ClientTimeZone LIMIT 30
queries.description: Time zones of purely organic search users who were never exposed to ad traffic, with their engagement.

queries.sql: WITH top_phrases AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 50) SELECT p.SearchPhrase, p.c FROM top_phrases p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase = p.SearchPhrase AND h.AdvEngineID <> 0) ORDER BY p.c DESC, p.SearchPhrase
queries.description: Among the 50 most frequent search phrases, those that also appear in at least one advertising-engine hit.

queries.sql: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY first_day) AS cumulative_users FROM first_seen GROUP BY first_day ORDER BY first_day
queries.description: New users per first-seen day with a running total of acquired users.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN UTMTerm = '' THEN 0 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(UTMTerm) <= 5 THEN 1 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(UTMTerm) <= 15 THEN 2 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(UTMTerm) <= 30 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS len_bucket, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMTerm) AS distinct_terms, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY CASE WHEN UTMTerm = '' THEN 0 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(UTMTerm) <= 5 THEN 1 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(UTMTerm) <= 15 THEN 2 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(UTMTerm) <= 30 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ORDER BY len_bucket
queries.description: Distribution of UTM term lengths in character buckets with distinct terms and users per bucket.

queries.sql: SELECT UserAgent, COUNT(*) AS views, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch, SUM(CASE WHEN FetchTiming > (SELECT AVG(FetchTiming) FROM hits WHERE FetchTiming > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slow_views FROM hits WHERE FetchTiming > 0 GROUP BY UserAgent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY slow_views DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 20
queries.description: For each browser, counts page views whose fetch time exceeds the global average fetch time.

queries.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT UTMSource, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '' AND EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UTMSource), b AS (SELECT UTMSource, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '' AND EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UTMSource), j AS (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.c, 0) > 0 THEN a.UTMSource ELSE b.UTMSource END AS src, COALESCE(a.c, 0) AS first_half, COALESCE(b.c, 0) AS second_half FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.UTMSource = b.UTMSource) SELECT src, first_half, second_half, first_half + second_half AS total FROM j ORDER BY total DESC, src LIMIT 50
queries.description: Compares UTM source volumes between the first and second half of July with a full outer join, exposing sources that appear or vanish suddenly.

queries.sql: SELECT URLRegionID FROM (SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' AND IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY URLRegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, URLRegionID LIMIT 50) a INTERSECT SELECT URLRegionID FROM (SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' AND IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY URLRegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, URLRegionID LIMIT 50) b ORDER BY URLRegionID
queries.description: URL regions that stay in the top 50 by engaged hits in both halves of July.

queries.sql: SELECT NetMajor, NetMinor, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) >= 5) GROUP BY NetMajor, NetMinor ORDER BY hit_count DESC, NetMajor, NetMinor LIMIT 20
queries.description: Profiles the .NET versions reported by IP-hopping users who used at least five distinct client IPs.

translations.q001: WITH early AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, EventTime, WatchID, IsNotBounce FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-03'), first_touch AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID AS first_source FROM (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID, TraficSourceID) AS rn FROM early) r WHERE rn = 1), user_stats AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS user_hits, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged, COUNT(DISTINCT TraficSourceID) AS sources FROM early GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.first_source, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(s.user_hits) AS avg_hits, CAST(SUM(s.engaged) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(s.user_hits) AS engaged_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN s.sources > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_source_users FROM first_touch f JOIN user_stats s ON f.UserID = s.UserID GROUP BY f.first_source ORDER BY users DESC, f.first_source  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q002: WITH heavy AS (SELECT BrowserCountry, UserID FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserCountry, UserID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000) SELECT c.BrowserCountry, c.users, c.hit_count FROM (SELECT BrowserCountry, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserCountry) AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heavy WHERE heavy.BrowserCountry = c.BrowserCountry) ORDER BY c.hit_count DESC, c.BrowserCountry LIMIT 30  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q003: WITH top_models AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel <> '' GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MobilePhoneModel LIMIT 10), mh AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel, ResolutionHeight, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE MobilePhoneModel IN (SELECT MobilePhoneModel FROM top_models) GROUP BY MobilePhoneModel, ResolutionHeight), ranked AS (SELECT MobilePhoneModel, ResolutionHeight, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MobilePhoneModel ORDER BY c DESC, ResolutionHeight) AS rn FROM mh) SELECT MobilePhoneModel, rn, ResolutionHeight, MobilePhoneModel || ' @' || CAST(ResolutionHeight AS VARCHAR) AS device_label, c FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY MobilePhoneModel, rn  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q004: SELECT FLOOR(CAST(span_min AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 30) * 30 AS span_bucket, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(c) AS hit_count FROM (SELECT UserID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c, MAX(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM ClientEventTime)) - MIN(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM ClientEventTime)) AS span_min FROM hits WHERE CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY UserID, EventDate HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) s GROUP BY span_bucket ORDER BY span_bucket  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q005: WITH ct AS (SELECT BrowserCountry, ClientTimeZone, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserCountry, ClientTimeZone), dom AS (SELECT BrowserCountry, ClientTimeZone FROM (SELECT BrowserCountry, ClientTimeZone, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BrowserCountry ORDER BY c DESC, ClientTimeZone) AS rn FROM ct) AS t WHERE rn = 1), ut AS (SELECT BrowserCountry, UserID, MIN(ClientTimeZone) AS tz_min, MAX(ClientTimeZone) AS tz_max FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserCountry, UserID) SELECT ut.BrowserCountry, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN ut.tz_min = d.ClientTimeZone AND ut.tz_max = d.ClientTimeZone THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS off_zone_users FROM ut JOIN dom AS d ON ut.BrowserCountry = d.BrowserCountry GROUP BY ut.BrowserCountry HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY off_zone_users DESC, users DESC, ut.BrowserCountry LIMIT 25  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q006: WITH daily AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) SELECT EventDate, c, users FROM daily WHERE EventDate IN (SELECT EventDate FROM daily EXCEPT SELECT EventDate FROM daily WHERE c >= (SELECT AVG(c) FROM daily)) ORDER BY EventDate  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q007: WITH ud AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dy FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), f AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(dy) AS first_day FROM ud GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.first_day, COUNT(DISTINCT f.UserID) AS cohort_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ud.dy = f.first_day + 1 THEN ud.UserID END) AS d1_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ud.dy = f.first_day + 7 THEN ud.UserID END) AS d7_users FROM f JOIN ud ON ud.UserID = f.UserID GROUP BY f.first_day ORDER BY f.first_day  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q008: SELECT p.SearchPhrase, p.users, p.hit_count FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50) AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase = p.SearchPhrase AND h.AdvEngineID <> 0) ORDER BY p.users DESC, p.hit_count DESC, p.SearchPhrase LIMIT 20  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q009: WITH churned AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY UserID EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate > '2013-07-07' GROUP BY UserID) SELECT TraficSourceID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS churned_users, COUNT(*) AS week1_hits FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM churned) GROUP BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY churned_users DESC, TraficSourceID  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q010: SELECT SearchEngineID, url_prefix, users, rn FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, url_prefix, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SearchEngineID ORDER BY users DESC, url_prefix) AS rn FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, lowerUTF8(substringUTF8(URL, 1, 24)) AS url_prefix, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 AND URL <> '' GROUP BY SearchEngineID, lowerUTF8(substringUTF8(URL, 1, 24))) g) r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY SearchEngineID, rn LIMIT 100  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q011: WITH ud AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dy FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), r AS (SELECT UserID, dy, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY dy) AS rn FROM ud), g AS (SELECT UserID, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN dy END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN dy END) AS gap FROM r WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) = 2) SELECT gap AS days_to_return, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY gap) AS cumulative_users FROM g GROUP BY gap ORDER BY gap  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q012: WITH ip_users AS (SELECT ClientIP, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 20), ip_flags AS (SELECT ClientIP, SUM(CASE WHEN CookieEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nocookie, COUNT(DISTINCT MobilePhoneModel) AS models FROM hits WHERE ClientIP IN (SELECT ClientIP FROM ip_users) GROUP BY ClientIP) SELECT i.ClientIP AS client_ip, i.users AS user_count, i.c AS hit_count, f.nocookie AS nocookie_hits, f.models AS model_count FROM ip_users i INNER JOIN ip_flags f ON i.ClientIP = f.ClientIP ORDER BY user_count DESC, hit_count DESC, client_ip LIMIT 30  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q013: SELECT n.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS search_users_with_ad_click FROM (SELECT EventDate, UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID > 0 AND IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY EventDate, UserID) n WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.UserID = n.UserID AND h.EventDate = n.EventDate AND h.AdvEngineID > 0) GROUP BY n.EventDate ORDER BY n.EventDate  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q014: SELECT dim, val, views, users, rn FROM (SELECT dim, val, views, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dim ORDER BY views DESC, val) AS rn FROM (SELECT 'source' AS dim, UTMSource AS val, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '' GROUP BY UTMSource UNION ALL SELECT 'medium' AS dim, UTMMedium AS val, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE UTMMedium <> '' GROUP BY UTMMedium UNION ALL SELECT 'content' AS dim, UTMContent AS val, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE UTMContent <> '' GROUP BY UTMContent) AS u) AS r WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY dim, rn  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q015: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07') AS first_week_users, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25') AS last_week_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY UserID INTERSECT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25' GROUP BY UserID) x) AS retained_users ORDER BY first_week_users  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q016: WITH first_hit AS (SELECT UserID, CASE WHEN UTMSource <> '' THEN 'utm' WHEN SocialSourcePage <> '' THEN 'social' WHEN SearchEngineID <> 0 THEN 'search' WHEN FromTag <> '' THEN 'tagged' ELSE 'direct' END AS channel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-03'), days AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.channel AS first_channel, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(AVG(d.active_days), 2) AS avg_active_days, SUM(CASE WHEN d.active_days >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loyal_users FROM first_hit f JOIN days d ON f.UserID = d.UserID WHERE f.rn = 1 GROUP BY f.channel ORDER BY users DESC, first_channel  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q017: WITH early AS (SELECT UserID, MAX(Income) AS income_band FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UserID), late AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UserID) SELECT e.income_band, COUNT(*) AS churned_users FROM early e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM late l WHERE l.UserID = e.UserID) GROUP BY e.income_band ORDER BY e.income_band  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q018: SELECT TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT UserID), 2) AS hits_per_user FROM hits GROUP BY TraficSourceID HAVING CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= (SELECT AVG(r) FROM (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS r FROM hits GROUP BY TraficSourceID) z) ORDER BY hits_per_user DESC, TraficSourceID  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q019: WITH t AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS sec FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-15'), g AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, sec, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN sec - MAX(sec) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_sess FROM t), s AS (SELECT UserID, SUM(new_sess) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sess_no FROM g), sz AS (SELECT UserID, sess_no, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY UserID, sess_no) SELECT CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN '1 hit' WHEN n <= 3 THEN '2-3 hits' WHEN n <= 10 THEN '4-10 hits' WHEN n <= 30 THEN '11-30 hits' ELSE '31+ hits' END AS session_size, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM sz GROUP BY CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN '1 hit' WHEN n <= 3 THEN '2-3 hits' WHEN n <= 10 THEN '4-10 hits' WHEN n <= 30 THEN '11-30 hits' ELSE '31+ hits' END ORDER BY MIN(n)  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q020: SELECT EventDate, ClientTimeZone, hit_count, refreshes, refresh_rate, rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, ClientTimeZone, hit_count, refreshes, CAST(refreshes AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / hit_count AS refresh_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY CAST(refreshes AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / hit_count DESC, ClientTimeZone) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, ClientTimeZone, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN IsRefresh = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refreshes FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-14' GROUP BY EventDate, ClientTimeZone HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) g) r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY EventDate, rn  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q021: WITH s AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID, UserID), tot AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS search_users FROM s GROUP BY SearchEngineID), conv AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS linking_users FROM s AS s_outer WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits l WHERE l.UserID = s_outer.UserID AND l.IsLink = 1) GROUP BY SearchEngineID) SELECT tot.SearchEngineID, tot.search_users, COALESCE(conv.linking_users, 0) AS linking_user_count, CAST(COALESCE(conv.linking_users, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tot.search_users AS link_rate FROM tot LEFT JOIN conv ON tot.SearchEngineID = conv.SearchEngineID ORDER BY tot.search_users DESC, tot.SearchEngineID LIMIT 20  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q022: SELECT RefererCategoryID, COUNT(*) AS hits_count, SUM(CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%.html%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS html_pages, SUM(CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_query, SUM(CASE WHEN Referer LIKE 'https://%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS secure_referers, COUNT(DISTINCT RefererHash) AS distinct_referers FROM hits WHERE Referer <> '' GROUP BY RefererCategoryID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY hits_count DESC, RefererCategoryID LIMIT 15  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'

translations.q061: WITH day_tot AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS total FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate), reg AS (SELECT EventDate, URLRegionID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, URLRegionID), ranked AS (SELECT EventDate, URLRegionID, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC, URLRegionID) AS rn FROM reg) SELECT r.EventDate AS day, r.URLRegionID AS top_region, r.c AS region_hits, t.total AS day_hits, CAST(r.c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) AS share FROM ranked r JOIN day_tot t ON r.EventDate = t.EventDate WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY day  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q062: WITH u AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage, UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT FUniqID) AS fu FROM hits WHERE FUniqID <> 0 GROUP BY BrowserLanguage, UserID) SELECT BrowserLanguage, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN fu > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_cookie_users, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fu > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS churn_share FROM u GROUP BY BrowserLanguage HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY users DESC, BrowserLanguage LIMIT 20  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
