translations.q030: WITH paid AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS paid_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS paid_counters FROM hits WHERE HasGCLID = 1 OR AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID), behaviour AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged, SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nojs FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM paid) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT p.UserID AS user_id, p.paid_hits AS paid_hit_count, p.paid_counters AS paid_counter_count, b.total AS total_hits, b.engaged AS engaged_hits, b.nojs AS nojs_hits, CAST(p.paid_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / b.total AS paid_share FROM paid p INNER JOIN behaviour b ON p.UserID = b.UserID WHERE p.paid_hits >= 10 ORDER BY paid_share DESC, paid_hit_count DESC, user_id LIMIT 50  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q031: WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_date FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT u_outer.first_date AS first_date, COUNT(*) AS never_engaged_users FROM u AS u_outer WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.UserID = u_outer.UserID AND h.IsNotBounce = 1) GROUP BY u_outer.first_date ORDER BY u_outer.first_date  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q032: SELECT scheme, has_query, COUNT(*) AS views, AVG(url_len) AS avg_len, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS counters FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS scheme, CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_query, lengthUTF8(URL) AS url_len, CounterID FROM hits WHERE URL <> '') AS s GROUP BY scheme, has_query ORDER BY scheme, has_query  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q033: WITH langs AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND BrowserLanguage <> '' GROUP BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, BrowserLanguage LIMIT 5), ph AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND BrowserLanguage IN (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM langs) GROUP BY BrowserLanguage, SearchPhrase), ranked AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage, SearchPhrase, users, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY users DESC, c DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM ph) SELECT BrowserLanguage, rn, SearchPhrase, users, c FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY BrowserLanguage, rn  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'

translations.q036: SELECT o.OS, o.users, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) FROM hits h WHERE h.OS = o.OS AND h.IsNotBounce = 1), 0) AS engaged_users FROM (SELECT OS, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY OS ORDER BY users DESC, OS LIMIT 10) o ORDER BY o.users DESC, o.OS  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q037: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS hits_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROUND(AVG(HistoryLength), 2) AS avg_history, SUM(CASE WHEN IsNotBounce = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged_hits FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) >= 5) THEN 'explorer' ELSE 'other' END AS segment, UserID, HistoryLength, IsNotBounce FROM hits) t GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q038: WITH h AS (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) SELECT h_outer.EventDate AS EventDate, h_outer.hr AS hr, h_outer.c AS c FROM h AS h_outer WHERE h_outer.c = (SELECT MAX(h2.c) FROM h h2 WHERE h2.EventDate = h_outer.EventDate) ORDER BY h_outer.EventDate, h_outer.hr LIMIT 100  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'

translations.q040: WITH t AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, TraficSourceID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime) * 86400 + EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS sec FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-10' AND IsArtifical = 0), m AS (SELECT UserID, WatchID, TraficSourceID, sec, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID, TraficSourceID) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN sec - MAX(sec) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID, TraficSourceID ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_start FROM t), s AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, sec, is_start, SUM(is_start) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec, WatchID, TraficSourceID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sess_no FROM m), sess AS (SELECT UserID, sess_no, MAX(CASE WHEN is_start = 1 THEN TraficSourceID END) AS entry_source, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(sec) - MIN(sec) AS duration_sec FROM s GROUP BY UserID, sess_no) SELECT entry_source, COUNT(*) AS sessions, ROUND(AVG(duration_sec), 1) AS avg_duration_sec, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS single_hit_pct, MAX(n) AS max_hits FROM sess GROUP BY entry_source ORDER BY sessions DESC, entry_source  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q041: WITH busy AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, CounterID LIMIT 20) SELECT b.CounterID, b.c, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.CounterID = b.CounterID AND h.OpenstatServiceName <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_openstat, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.CounterID = b.CounterID AND h.SocialNetwork <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_social FROM busy b ORDER BY b.c DESC, b.CounterID  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'

translations.q046: WITH top_counters AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 5), weekly AS (SELECT CounterID, CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) AS wk, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS paid_users, COUNT(*) AS paid_hits, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counters) GROUP BY CounterID, CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER)) SELECT CounterID, wk, paid_users, paid_hits, CAST(engaged AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / paid_hits AS engaged_rate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wk ORDER BY paid_users DESC, CounterID) AS week_rank FROM weekly ORDER BY wk, week_rank  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'

translations.q086: WITH c AS (SELECT CounterID, AdvEngineID, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, AdvEngineID) SELECT c1.CounterID, c1.AdvEngineID, c1.hit_cnt, (SELECT SUM(c2.hit_cnt) FROM c c2 WHERE c2.CounterID = c1.CounterID) AS counter_total FROM c c1 WHERE c1.AdvEngineID <> 0 ORDER BY c1.hit_cnt DESC, c1.CounterID, c1.AdvEngineID LIMIT 15  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q087: SELECT d, new_users, single_hit_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY d) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT first_day AS d, COUNT(*) AS new_users, SUM(CASE WHEN hit_count = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_hit_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) AS f GROUP BY first_day) AS g ORDER BY d  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q088: WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0), an AS (SELECT UserID, d, d + 1 AS nd FROM a WHERE d < 31), v AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS vd FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID = 0) SELECT an.d AS day_of_month, COUNT(*) AS ad_users, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(v.vd, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_organic_next_day FROM an LEFT JOIN v ON v.UserID = an.UserID AND v.vd = an.nd GROUP BY an.d ORDER BY day_of_month  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q089: SELECT CASE WHEN OriginalURL LIKE '%gclid=%' THEN 'gclid' WHEN OriginalURL LIKE '%utm_source=%' THEN 'utm' WHEN OriginalURL LIKE '%openstat%' THEN 'openstat' WHEN OriginalURL LIKE '%?%' THEN 'other_params' WHEN OriginalURL <> '' THEN 'plain' ELSE 'missing' END AS url_marker, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, AVG(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_rate FROM hits GROUP BY url_marker ORDER BY url_marker  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q090: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM first_seen GROUP BY first_day ORDER BY first_day  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q091: SELECT a.OS, a.users AS users_first_half, b.users AS users_second_half, ROUND(100.0 * b.users / a.users, 2) AS second_vs_first_pct FROM (SELECT OS, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-15' GROUP BY OS) a JOIN (SELECT OS, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE EventDate > '2013-07-15' GROUP BY OS) b ON a.OS = b.OS WHERE a.users >= 500 ORDER BY second_vs_first_pct DESC, a.OS LIMIT 15  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q092: WITH rd AS (SELECT EventDate, RegionID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, RegionID) SELECT a.EventDate, a.RegionID, a.c FROM rd a WHERE a.c = (SELECT MAX(b.c) FROM rd b WHERE b.EventDate = a.EventDate) ORDER BY a.EventDate, a.RegionID LIMIT 100  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q093: SELECT ClientTimeZone, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS organic_users, COUNT(*) AS pageviews, AVG(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_rate FROM hits WHERE TraficSourceID = 2 AND UserID NOT IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0) GROUP BY ClientTimeZone HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY organic_users DESC, ClientTimeZone LIMIT 30  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q094: WITH top_phrases AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 50) SELECT p.SearchPhrase, p.c FROM top_phrases p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase = p.SearchPhrase AND h.AdvEngineID <> 0) ORDER BY p.c DESC, p.SearchPhrase  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q095: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY first_day) AS cumulative_users FROM first_seen GROUP BY first_day ORDER BY first_day  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q096: SELECT CASE WHEN UTMTerm = '' THEN 0 WHEN lengthUTF8(UTMTerm) <= 5 THEN 1 WHEN lengthUTF8(UTMTerm) <= 15 THEN 2 WHEN lengthUTF8(UTMTerm) <= 30 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS len_bucket, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMTerm) AS distinct_terms, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY CASE WHEN UTMTerm = '' THEN 0 WHEN lengthUTF8(UTMTerm) <= 5 THEN 1 WHEN lengthUTF8(UTMTerm) <= 15 THEN 2 WHEN lengthUTF8(UTMTerm) <= 30 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ORDER BY len_bucket  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q097: SELECT UserAgent, COUNT(*) AS views, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch, SUM(CASE WHEN FetchTiming > (SELECT AVG(FetchTiming) FROM hits WHERE FetchTiming > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slow_views FROM hits WHERE FetchTiming > 0 GROUP BY UserAgent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY slow_views DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 20  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q098: WITH a AS (SELECT UTMSource, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '' AND EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UTMSource), b AS (SELECT UTMSource, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '' AND EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY UTMSource), j AS (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.c, 0) > 0 THEN a.UTMSource ELSE b.UTMSource END AS src, COALESCE(a.c, 0) AS first_half, COALESCE(b.c, 0) AS second_half FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.UTMSource = b.UTMSource) SELECT src, first_half, second_half, first_half + second_half AS total FROM j ORDER BY total DESC, src LIMIT 50  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q099: SELECT URLRegionID FROM (SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' AND IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY URLRegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, URLRegionID LIMIT 50) a INTERSECT SELECT URLRegionID FROM (SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' AND IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY URLRegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, URLRegionID LIMIT 50) b ORDER BY URLRegionID  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q100: SELECT NetMajor, NetMinor, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) >= 5) GROUP BY NetMajor, NetMinor ORDER BY hit_count DESC, NetMajor, NetMinor LIMIT 20  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
